_doc.purpose: OpenClaw patch manifest. Apply in listed order via apply_patch.py.

fields.file: relative path under patch/ to the unified diff
fields.target_glob: glob (relative to OC_HOST_OPENCLAW) for content-hashed bundles; substituted into the patch's CHUNK placeholder
fields.target_path: exact relative path (used instead of target_glob when filename is stable)
fields.target_glob_all: recursive glob (relative to OC_HOST_OPENCLAW); patch is applied to every match (used when the same source file is duplicated across plugin bundles)
fields.chunk_placeholder: string in patch that maps to the matched glob suffix (default: CHUNK)
fields.idempotent_marker: literal string in patched output; if present in target file, the patch is treated as already applied

patches.summary: emit model.usage OTel event from CLI agent path
emit model.usage OTel event from gateway path
emit tool.call event payloads from selection path
tool-call diagnostics handler in OTel extension
hijack sandbox tool exec to external bridge when OPENCLAW_EXEC_BRIDGE env is set
route fs-bridge read/write/stat/etc through the same external bridge
coerce JSON-stringified array/object args into real arrays before AJV validates (Qwen3 emits nested args as JSON strings). Applied to every pi-ai copy (main + per-plugin bundles).
